name: boshghabyar
description: بشقاب‌یار — ثبت وعده، محاسبه ارزش غذایی و پیشنهاد متعادل/اقتصادی

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @boshghabyar/core && npm run typecheck -w @boshghabyar/api && npm run typecheck -w @boshghabyar/web && npm run typecheck -w @boshghabyar/mobile
scripts.build: npm run core:build && npm run api:build && npm run web:build
scripts.test: npm run core:build && npm run core:test && npm run test -w @boshghabyar/api
scripts.text:check: node scripts/fix-zwnj.mjs --check packages apps/api apps/web/src apps/android/app/src apps/mobile/src docs README.md scripts
scripts.text:fix: node scripts/fix-zwnj.mjs --write packages apps/api apps/web/src apps/android/app/src apps/mobile/src docs README.md scripts
